user_idea_text: A web app for youth soccer coaches that auto-generates fair playing-time lineups from the roster and texts them to parents before each game, so coaches stop juggling spreadsheets on the sideline
user_idea_brief: A web app for youth soccer coaches that auto-generates fair playing-time lineups from the roster and texts them to parents to replace manual spreadsheet management.
derived_market: The youth sports management software market encompasses digital tools designed to streamline administrative, logistical, and communication tasks for volunteer and professional organizers. It focuses on reducing the operational burden of managing team rosters, scheduling, and parent-coach communications in amateur athletics.
derived_buyer: Volunteer Youth Soccer Team Coaches and Managers

kill_risks.claim: The search evidence shows established team-communication alternatives: Spond is described by a grassroots user as a “game changer,” while TeamLinkt and Stack Team App are presented as apps with communication plus roster/team-management capabilities; this makes FairPlay Ledger’s parent texting and roster workflow look bundled into broader platforms.

The strongest evidence for the specific fair-lineup concept is an App Store result for allPlay Soccer, whose snippet says “Just balanced, fair lineups in seconds,” indicating a direct category incumbent; the evidence does not establish its pricing, adoption, or feature depth.
The market's loudest complaint in this space. A product like yours must not trigger it: Cannot prove equal playing time during active games.

top.name: FieldChangeAlert
top.one_liner: FieldChangeAlert turns authoritative venue-calendar changes into timely, family-ready notifications without waiting for a coach to discover and re-enter the update.

top.name: DraftRuleLedger
top.one_liner: Give youth-sports directors a defensible, consistent way to explain every roster placement without exposing sensitive player information or reconstructing decisions from scattered spreadsheets.

top.name: ClubTravelCompare
top.one_liner: Give soccer families an evidence-based view of seasonal driving burden and club commitments before hidden travel expectations cause costly club changes.

top.name: RakeProof
top.one_liner: Automate proof and deposit refunds for youth-sports volunteer duties without requiring a team parent to inspect every field or snack-bar shift.

top.name: Saturday Scan
top.one_liner: Give club directors one ranked Saturday view of cancellation risk across every field, then synchronize decisions and roster confirmations in batches instead of managing weather game by game.

evaluated_idea.name: FairPlay Ledger
evaluated_idea.value_proposition: For youth soccer coaches who want to stop juggling spreadsheets on the sideline, FairPlay Ledger is a web app that auto-generates fair playing-time lineups and texts them to parents, making rotations easier to run and easier to explain.
evaluated_idea.mechanism_summary: The wedge is not another roster spreadsheet: it turns fair playing-time planning into a repeatable coach workflow, then proactively texts the resulting lineup to parents.

refinement.because: Cannot prove equal playing time during active games
